title: The Day the King Danced
reflectionQuestion: David was so glad and so thankful that he danced down the road with all his might. I wonder what makes your heart so happy that you want to sing or dance?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (David dances before the Ark, 2 Sam 6). Register=JOY (fills the lane's joy/celebration gap). Feeling-first open (so glad you can't hold still). SUBTRACTION: Uzzah ENTIRELY absent (no death); Michal ENTIRELY absent (no contempt) -- scripture extract bounded to 6:12-15 to match. One image: a king dancing in the dust like a child. Ending lets joy simply EXIST (non-moralizing, per ending-shape-variety) + God loves a happy heart. 'God' in prose (key verse WEB reads 'Yahweh' -- raw scripture, fine). Voice VOICE_BARNABAS_ENCOURAGER (uplifting/joyful).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
